reviews.review:
It's such a shame because you can see there's a game here which needs another dozen or so passes to make it playable. 

I feel actually tricked in that this game should still be in Early Access, even for the 2 bucks I paid for it.

Visually this game looks so good. I don't mean it has the best graphics, but I mean the design, the atmosphere, the settings, the flair. It has such a hip sci-fi vibe that really makes me wish for this game to succeed.

I have to admit though, I made a mistake and perceived the game as a CoD zombies clone similar to Sker Ritual but in space, rather than a L4d clone. It's not the games fault, it's what i wanted it to be, when I saw development footage and trailers.

The game feels like it has a great fundamental base, but is missing the content, the depth, the fine tuning. I expected it to be a CoD-like round based survival game in a sci-fi setting, with unique weapons and customization, mini quests with rewards, easter eggs, mini bosses, grand Easter egg bosses, all this carried by an amazing mysterious story that keeps you hooked on what happens next. Instead this game is a L4D clone a la walk from A to B. Most normal guns felt too similar for me or maybe it's because gunplay in general didn't feel satisfying enough. Though the special weapons help the issue a bit, until you're out of ammo. Some special aliens are a copy from L4D, some are new, which is neat. The levels are too similar in my opinion. Not setting wise, but the gameplay gets repetitive after a while. I was playing and constantly wondered, why I should l play this over L4D. It's a clone, but it doesn't offer enough to stand out. Like I said the setting, the fundament, makes it special, but it hasn't been given more than walls and a door, a few chairs and a table. The rest of furniture is missing.

Again this is okay, because it's advertised as such, but I am just missing the replay ability. I wish I could give mixed review, because it's not what I wanted it to be. I give a thumbs up, because I still enjoyed the world that it plays in and want the devs to succeed.

reviews.review: I feel like I would be canceled on Twitter if I say anything related to the Design choice for this game so instead i'll just state that the game feels like a unfinished project.

[h1]The Anacrusis truly feels like a prototype Back 4 Blood rather  than L4D. Suffers from abymsal sound design clarifaction, soulless banter, rather poor optimization, unclear visual design and the classic modern game design.[/h1] 
 Having played lot of L4D and a bit Back 4 Blood. This game sadly doesn't fit the bill. It really feels like a prototype game, it even has sound disappearing when lot of sounds play out. 
[h2] Optimization [/h2]
Its optimization is rather questionable, when specials or lot of enemies spawn in, my FPS will spike really hard and freeze me. Even with my low end PC, i say this is a bad sign.  Exactly the same as Back 4 Blood.
[h2] Enemy and Sound design [/h2]
The enemy design is not clear what it does. Given how the sound design is really abysmal; you really don't know what is happening unless you're seeing it with your eyes. 
Common enemies attack have very short first strike animation and not clear footstep or sounds. Remember L4D? You would know exactly when a zombie was on to you or was about to attack you or if it was idle near you. 


The same applies to the specials. They are no signs and only the bots helped by telling when someone was near.  [b]How can you have a game without a sound design where split second decisions and FPS shooting is crucial? The whole sound design makes me give a big red card on this.[/b]
The brute should have been more of a boss enemy rather than a mini-tank of L4D or a nuisance. Sadly, the bots are  weak against him since they don't retreat or stay too close to you when they fight him
[h3] Characters [/h3]
The characters themselves are lacking, you don't feel emotion in them. It is like they are robots or voiced by an AI. i seen this even in Back 4 blood. Everything they say is forgettable, only when you get hit, they yell "pulse pulse", warning the players to use their "shove". 

I am heavily displeased how we are in the 2020s, and the friendly AI can't be ordered around, take special weapons and use them. We have to get mods to do that,which further shows how solo play is really neglected.
[h2] Pulse(shove) [/h2]
Ah yes, the pulse. Well, what I can say? Such tech should have been explained at the start of the first level to teach the players what is it and how to use it.  Unlike the shove in L4D where it is obvious what it does; in this game, you don't know its radius and limits from first using it. Not only that, i see the pulse has a delay(after it has been used) when it gets used and [b]that is exactly why i hated the common enemies hitting you too fast. [/b]


There is nothing more to say really, it is a Back 4 Blood prototype than sticking its roots to L4D. And i don't mean literal design or style. i mean its simplicty and clear visual design(as well as audio). [b]I can't understand what is going on, who is who and where is that who.  [/b]
It should have been for characters to speak more and give hints, some subtle hints like specific special enemies or what to do. But it is classic script, "we are going the right way through here" (not literal example)

[u]Fix the sound design, optimization and the visual design and maybe we have an actual game.[/u]  Sound design is crucial as well as immersive or even funny banter between the player characters. My ears should be my second pair of eyes crucial as my own eyes.

Also, fix that boring UI, both game and especially the main menu. Having to take a whole minute to find how to make a lobby and then start a game. See? Even the main menus in modern game design have become obtuse

[h1]Get this only on a heavy sale and do not hope it will be  close to L4D. Think of it as something else.  [/h1]
Trying to think this game is close to L4D, i would call that an insult to L4D. Let's not  throw that term around randomly without a reason, yes?

What if Left for Dead was obnoxiously woke, boring, cringe, not at all grim dark, and way more janky? 
well Anacrusis is here to answer that question.
it's not good, its not terrible, but the gay pandering obviously didnt work but absolutely no one is playing this game.
Chet Faliszek is an out of touch ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ to people in the industry
